source: PostHog execute-sql with existing Keating observation keys
query: SELECT count() AS captured_events, uniqExact(tuple(JSONExtractString(properties, 'conversation_id'), JSONExtractString(properties, 'turn_id'))) AS distinct_turns FROM events WHERE event = 'openui_turn_observed' AND JSONExtractString(properties, '$host') IN ('keating.help', 'chat.keating.help') AND JSONExtractString(properties, 'app_version') = '4.2.0' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-11 00:00:00', 'UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-18 18:30:00', 'UTC')
